pass.answer: - A compaction takes eight minutes but cron starts one every five, with no lock, so two runs overlap and rewrite manifest.json over each other.
| 1 | CRITICAL | Operations | The `*/5` compact entry has no flock, unlike ingest; concurrent runs lose manifest entries | Wrap it in flock |
- Two compactions at once race on manifest.json and the last rename wins.
| 2 | HIGH | Failure | wxarchive compact runs without a lock, so a manifest update can be lost in parallel runs | Add a lock |
- The crontab does not prevent overlapping runs: an eight-minute compaction under `*/5` lets two passes rewrite `manifest.json`.

fail.answer: Overlapping compact runs are fine because the rename is atomic.
- The compact subcommand needs better error handling.
- The tools should log which segment they read.
- Compaction should be tested with concurrent ingest.
fail.why: ingest beside compaction, not two compactions
